title: USGS debris-flow gate-release laser measurements
question: How do flow-depth dynamics compare across instruments in the flume experiments?
measurement_dates: Source campaign dates include 2022-10-05/06 and 2024-04-05/06/08/10/11; specific gate-release dates are preserved in the retained records.
variables_and_units: Variables and units are preserved in native column headers, instrument metadata and source dictionaries; see evidence anchors below.
independent_units: Complete gate-release run and independent instrument.
validation_design: Complete gate-release run and independent instrument. Verify identifiers before allocating groups; the partition is not executed or frozen by this acquisition.
author_preprocessing: Source laser-derived time-series tables, not untouched swath UBH binary. Large UBH and natural-release files are excluded. The provided MATLAB code was retained as context, not executed.
prior_analysis_and_limits: The USGS source already evaluates swath-laser monitoring at the flume. Cross-instrument agreement alone is validation, not a new constitutive debris-flow law. Instrument agreement is not independent run replication.
missingness: Native blanks, sentinels, absent records and source quality flags are preserved. No imputation performed by the curator. Exact missingness semantics come from source dictionaries/headers; no universal missing-value rule is imposed.
calibration: Use the retained source calibration files/standards and instrument metadata where provided. Absence of an explicit calibration record is not replaced by an assumed calibration.
